$BB is up 100% since I first covered it.

Had earnings today. Beat revenue by $14M. EBITDA up 144% YoY. First positive Q1 operating cash flow in 9 years.

Most people think BB is a dead phone company or a meme stock with a Reddit army. They don't realize BB owns QNX. And most people have no idea what QNX even is.

QNX is the operating system that runs underneath 275 million cars. The invisible software layer that makes the vehicle work. 10 of the top 10 automakers run it. Every major chip vendor in physical compute is partnered with it. $NVDA. $AMD. $INTC. $ARM. $QCOM. $NXPI. $TXN.
And their royalty model means revenue compounds with every car, robot, and device that ships.

Still funny to me that people are out here calling this a meme stock while QNX is quietly becoming the software backbone of physical AI. $BB

Now expanding into robotics, medical devices, and industrial automation. CEO called it the fastest growing segment in the company. 👀
